displaysHint: One row per display. Port 0 means the display's own network port when Connection is set to the display, which is 5000 for Laser Nova, Laser Sky and Riva R2, and 4664 for Cactus and Veneer 2. A serial converter needs its own port. The Set ID must match the ID in the display's menu. The MAC address is only needed to switch a display on over the network, by Wake-on-LAN.
Name: Name
pollHelp: How often power, volume, mute and input are read back, to pick up changes made on the display itself
